items.title: Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Proposes Officer Liability Amendment For Shareholder Vote
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (NasdaqGS:TTWO) has proposed an Officer Exculpation Amendment to its Restated Certificate of Incorporation. The amendment would limit the liability of certain officers to the fullest extent permitted under Delaware law. Shareholders are being asked to vote on the proposal after the Board recommended its approval.
